proposals.identity: Metal commodity; not element, ions, compounds, minerals or every Mg-bearing alloy/scrap. No universal purity threshold.
proposals.exact_criticality: EU original 2024/1252 Annex I Section 1(i): strategic. Broader Annex II magnesium is not mechanically copied.
evidence_locators: USGS MCS2026 printed pp122-123 / PDF126-127
USGS SIR2025-5021 Magnesium Metal section
proposals.microbial_decision: No mechanism accepted. Robinson2010 doi:10.1016/j.actbio.2009.10.007 studies corrosion in sterile broth and antibacterial effects; this is not demonstration of microbial Mg-metal recovery. PMC8953398 tests inorganic metabolites on AZ31B/AZ63B alloys, not a cultured pure-metal production assay.

proposals.identity: Commercial silicon metal distinct from element, silica, silicates, ferrosilicon and silicones; further purification produces semiconductor/solar grades.
proposals.exact_criticality: EU original 2024/1252 Annex I Section 1(o): strategic; Annex II Section 1(ac): critical. Canada2024 inventory designation not newly verified or curated.
evidence_locators: USGS MCS2026 printed pp170-171 / PDF174-175
USGS Silicon2019 printed p67.1 / PDF2, contextual identity cross-check
proposals.microbial_decision: No mechanism accepted. Search leads concern impurities in quartz/silica and planned battery-waste separation; neither proves microbial metal production. Existing diatom-silica mechanism belongs to silicon element context.

proposals.identity: Metal commodity including sponge and downstream forms, not titanium element, oxide pigment, mineral concentrates or a specific alloy/waste.
proposals.exact_criticality: EU original 2024/1252 Annex I Section 1(p): strategic; Annex II Section 1(af): critical.
evidence_locators: USGS MCS2026 printed pp196-197 / PDF200-201
USGS SIR2025-5021 Titanium Sponge Metal section contextual cross-check
proposals.microbial_decision: Known DOI 10.1093/nsr/nwag426 is already curated in titanium.yaml. Its passive-film experiment is not copied as recovered metal or metal-production evidence. This pass inspected the existing record/dossier, not a new independent re-review of its full experiment.

proposals.identity: Coke-making commodity following EIA suitable bituminous-coal definition. Coal is not coke, carbon element or a mineral species. Official uses of metallurgical coal differ.
proposals.exact_criticality: EU original 2024/1252 Annex II Section 1(i): critical. US2025 metallurgical-coal designation is not silently copied.
evidence_locators: EIA Coking coal and Metallurgical coal glossary entries
USGS FS2026-3061 version1.1 August2026 pp1-2
Shahbazi2024 DOI10.22044/jme.2023.13127.2387 full15-page publisher PDF: Methods2.1-2.4 pp583-584; Table1 p583; Tables3-5 pp589-590; Figures4-5 pp590,592; Section3.4 p591 and Section4 p593
proposals.microbial_decision: Accept narrow PE culture-associated sulfur-content comparison after complete treatment including HCl wash. No isolated sulfur yield, coal mass yield, member-specific mechanism, cross-method ranking, retained coking performance or industrial deployment. Preserve thymol/acid controls and figure/table inconsistencies.
proposals.verified_measurement_scope: PE total sulfur 1.85% initially (Table1), 0.51% after20d/20%inoculum/5%pulp (Table3), 1.25% uninoculated (Table4). Reported72.43%/32.43% are concentration changes, not sulfur mass balances.
proposals.controls_limits: 3%w/w thymol only in uninoculated comparisons; acidified makeup water; final10%v/v HCl wash; no chemistry-matched cell-free culture control; replicate count/error-bar definition not found in fulltext; 9K/K9 and iron amendment wording inconsistent; non-PE calculations and ash comparisons conflict.

proposals.identity: Natural-plus-synthetic commercial graphite family directly grounded in USGS combined commodity treatment. Overlaps existing natural-graphite subset; neither synonym nor disjoint partition. Not mineral-species identity or carbon element.
proposals.exact_criticality: EU original 2024/1252 Annex II Section1(v): critical. Article3(3) explicitly discusses synthetic graphite in strategic-list review, while AnnexI(k) retains battery-grade qualifier. Other inventory jurisdictions not newly mapped.
evidence_locators: USGS Graphite2021 yearbook advance release December2024 pp32.1-32.2 / PDF2-3, text and page images
EU original Article3(3), AnnexI(k), AnnexII(v)
proposals.microbial_decision: No mechanism. Existing Langwaldt2007 mixed-sulfide lead is not graphite purification. Roy2023 DOI10.1021/acssuschemeng.2c07262 remains method/control/product-specification deferred as documented in round10. No new fulltext acquisition for Roy2023 claimed. New Recycling2026 11(8):142 lead explicitly says battery-grade graphite was not assessed; publisher direct403 prevents full verification.

proposals.identity: End-use-qualified products from natural and synthetic graphite; overlaps origin-based scopes without being equivalent.
proposals.exact_criticality: EU original AnnexI Section1(k): strategic. No accepted separate root in this round.
evidence_locators: JRC2023 foresight Table16 printed p243 / PDF246
USGS Graphite2021 p32.1 mentions99.95%C for natural-graphite battery applications; this is not a universal multi-product qualification test.
proposals.missing: Explicit accepted product/form scope, impurity and morphology/performance specifications, and primary controlled purification/reuse evidence meeting those specifications. Natural origin, high C percentage alone, or metal removal from spent anodes is insufficient.

proposals.identity: JRC maps refined battery lithium to carbonate and hydroxide products and separately to electrolyte salts; not lithium atom or any Li-bearing solution.
proposals.exact_criticality: EU original AnnexI Section1(h): strategic. Broader AnnexII(s) lithium does not establish product grade.
evidence_locators: JRC2023 foresight Table16 printed p243 / PDF246
EC2025 lithium one-page strategic-material factsheet, read in full; no product impurity specification.
proposals.missing: Choose product/form and verify grade-specific impurities/qualification from a primary specification; acquire full controlled recovery and final-product analysis. Existing jadarite leaching establishes dissolved Li only, not battery-grade product.

proposals.identity: JRC includes high-purity manganese sulphate and high-purity electrolytic manganese as battery precursors/intermediates, distinct from any Mn ion or oxide.
proposals.exact_criticality: EU original AnnexI Section1(j): strategic. Broader AnnexII(u) manganese does not establish product grade.
evidence_locators: JRC2023 foresight Table16 printed p243 / PDF246; Section2.1 printed p21 / PDF24
EC2025 manganese one-page strategic-material factsheet, read in full; no numeric purity standard.
proposals.missing: Resolve sulfate/electrolytic or other product scope and impurity specification. Primary bioleaching dissolution or Mn-oxide formation is not accepted as a qualified battery precursor.

proposals.identity: JRC distinguishes nickel sulphate precursor from ClassI nickel or metallurgical intermediate; different feedstock and product categories cannot be equated.
proposals.exact_criticality: EU original AnnexI Section1(l): strategic and AnnexII Section1(w): critical, both expressly battery grade.
evidence_locators: JRC2023 foresight Table16 printed p243 / PDF246
proposals.missing: Resolve qualified product form and specification, rather than assigning battery grade to all high-Ni metal or nickel leachate. ENICON/CORDIS project reporting and battery-LCA leads do not replace controlled finished-product evidence.

proposals.identity: EIA includes coking coal plus pulverized coal consumed in making steel; USGS FS2026-3061 uses met/coking synonymy in coke-oven scope.
proposals.exact_criticality: US Final2025 List of Critical Minerals, 7November2025, Federal Register90:50494-50497, metallurgical-coal row on50497 inspected.
evidence_locators: EIA Metallurgical coal glossary
USGS FS2026-3061 version1.1 pp1-2
GovInfo2025-19813 table p50497
proposals.missing: Authority-specific reconciliation of whether the US designation includes pulverized-injection/non-coking coal and a stable scope distinct from coking-coal. Do not mark synonymy, disjointness or coverage of all US coal.

Per-query times were not separately retained. Crossref title search rows=3 did not resolve the Tabas paper; DOI came from author-uploaded copy and was then confirmed on publisher page.
web_search.integrity_result: No matching correction or retraction notice identified in returned exact-title searches for Shahbazi2024, Roy2023 or Li2026. Null/abiotic and product-grade queries inform limits; this is not exhaustive or a Crossmark audit.
